description: VASOL TECH AB, DBA VASOL TECH, is a Swedish company specialized in providing solar power solutions for remote and crisis-affected regions, focusing on clean, self-sufficient energy systems for both personal and commercial use. The company operates in the renewable energy sector, offering products such as solar power generation units and energy storage systems, and serves markets globally.

description: Alotta AS, DBA Alotta, is a Norwegian company specialized in renewable energy solutions, with a focus on floating photovoltaic systems and hardware for renewable energy. The company provides planning, installation, and maintenance services for renewable energy systems, including floating solar power solutions that integrate with existing energy sources. Alotta also engages in renewable energy semiconductor manufacturing and operates within the semiconductors sector. Its services are designed for industries and communities reliant on fossil fuel generators, particularly in remote or off-grid locations.

Mitra Chem Incorporated is an American private company engaged in the development and manufacturing of lithium-ion battery materials, with a focus on iron-based cathode materials. The company operates in the semiconductor and renewable energy sectors, providing battery materials for electric vehicles, energy storage, and related applications. Mitra Chem utilizes proprietary machine learning technology to support research and development and manufacturing processes, and its products are used by original equipment manufacturers and battery cell suppliers. The company is also involved in joint development partnerships and has received funding from the US Department of Energy.
core_offerings: Lithium Iron Phosphate Plus Cathode Manufacturing

description: Sowin Power AS, DBA Sowin Power, is a Norwegian company specialized in the development and sale of power stations for the cabin and residential markets, focusing on clean energy solutions for individuals and households. The company combines solar panels, wind turbines, and used electric car batteries in its power stations, designed to be mounted outside houses and cottages. Sowin Power serves customers in Norway and Sweden.
core_offerings: Inverter and Remote Monitoring System Integration

description: BRF Vivstavarvsvägen is a Swedish company specialized in the production and installation of solar panels and related rooftop work, operating primarily in the renewable energy sector. The company focuses on solar energy production and rooftop renovation projects, serving residential and commercial clients seeking sustainable energy solutions and property renovation services.

Zakuro, Inc., DBA Zakuro, is an American company engaged in the development and manufacturing of solid-state lithium batteries, with a focus on technologies that utilize lithium metal anodes. The company operates within the semiconductor industry, with activities in hardware and renewable energy semiconductor manufacturing, and serves sectors such as energy storage, automotive, and consumer electronics. Zakuro also develops battery technologies that aim to improve energy density and safety compared to traditional lithium-ion batteries.

Rusaccum LLC (ООО «РУСАККУМ»), DBA Rusaccum (Русаккум), is a Russian limited liability company specialized in the development of solid-state batteries, with a focus on lithium-ion batteries and solid-state lithium sources. The company operates in the scientific-technical sector, developing technologies to enhance lithium-ion battery efficiency, producing materials for lithium-ion batteries, and designing and supplying lithium-ion battery cells and batteries for specific applications. Rusaccum also conducts expert evaluations of materials and batteries using electrochemical testing and collaborates with scientific and educational institutions to address scientific and technological challenges in the green energy sector, hybrid and electric vehicles, and energy storage applications. The company serves both European and Russian markets.
core_offerings: Electric and Hybrid Vehicle Battery Solutions

description: Nuvvon Inc. is an American company engaged in the development, scale-up, and commercialization of solid-state lithium metal batteries. The company focuses on solid polymer electrolyte technology, which is designed to be flame-resistant, flexible, and suitable for roll-to-roll production and integration with standard Li-ion equipment. Nuvvon serves the energy storage sector, providing battery solutions for business clients.

WBS Mobility S.A., DBA WBS Mobility, is a Polish company engaged in the development and operation of a nationwide network of publicly accessible fast charging stations for electric vehicles. The company also provides infrastructure services for electric vehicle charging and is involved in the renewables and environment sector, including solar electric power generation. WBS Mobility serves both individual consumers and businesses seeking charging solutions in Poland.

Xinyang Technology Co., Ltd. (芯量科技股份有限公司), known as SolidEdge Solution, is a Taiwanese company engaged in the development and manufacturing of solid-state lithium battery materials and components. The company operates as both a manufacturer and developer, providing in-house production of cathodes, anodes, and electrolytes, as well as integrated solutions that include material development and cell integration technologies. SolidEdge Solution serves the automotive and energy sectors, with a focus on lightweight, flexible, and high-energy density battery technologies, and collaborates with industry and academic partners to advance battery materials and technologies.

Guangzhou Rongjie Energy Technology Co., Ltd., DBA RJETech, is a Chinese company specialized in the research and development, production, and sales of battery cells and systems for energy storage and electric vehicles. The company manufactures lithium battery and energy storage equipment, as well as lithium battery cathode materials, and also engages in lithium battery recycling and reuse. RJETech serves a range of markets, including generation-side, grid-side, consumption-side, residential, and electric vehicle sectors, and is part of a larger group with operations spanning lithium battery manufacturing, energy storage solutions, and related resource-materials-product-application-recycling activities.

Kraftkar Energi AS, DBA Kraftkar Energi, is a Norwegian company specialized in renewable energy solutions, with a focus on solar energy. The company provides solar energy products and services, including outdoor solar panels, building-integrated photovoltaics, and free-standing solar panels, serving residential, industrial, commercial, and off-grid energy needs. Kraftkar Energi also operates as a supplier of green energy and offers installation and maintenance services for solar panels, as well as after-sales support and building-integrated solutions. The company is part of the Med enerett group, which is involved in renewable energy projects and initiatives.

Carita och Torbjörn is a Swedish company specialized in the production and sale of wind power equipment and related services. The company operates a wind power park in Kronoberget, serving customers interested in renewable energy solutions.

description: Sunnytek Solar Sweden AB, DBA Sunnytek, is a Swedish company specialized in solar, wind, and thermal energy technologies. The company provides products and solutions for energy storage, lighting, and security, serving both residential and commercial markets globally. Sunnytek also operates in the laser optronics sector and is registered with Grön Teknik for modern energy technology management. Its operations include offices in the Nordic region, Africa, South America, and Asia.

description: Ecopwr is a Swedish company specialized in sustainable energy solutions, focusing on products such as solar panels, power stations, solar generators, golf vehicles, spare batteries, and golf carts designed for outdoor activities, emergencies, and daily energy needs. The company emphasizes environmentally friendly and energy-efficient products with solar charging capabilities and silent operation. Ecopwr serves customers in multiple languages, including English, Swedish, German, Norwegian, and Finnish.

Sichuan Wanbang Shenghui New Energy Technology Co., Ltd. (四川万邦胜辉新能源科技有限公司), DBA Wanbang New Energy (万邦新能源), is a Chinese manufacturing company specialized in the research, development, and production of energy new materials, with a focus on solid-state batteries and related materials. The company serves primarily the Chinese market, providing products and services to clients in the energy and new materials sectors. In addition to manufacturing, it operates research and production facilities and engages in technology transfer through partnerships with educational institutions and industrial enterprises.

Jiangsu Xinliyuan Technology Co., Ltd. (江苏新锂元科技有限公司), DBA Xinliyuan (新锂元), is a Chinese technology company specialized in the research, development, and production of solid-state lithium batteries, salt lake lithium extraction, and comprehensive recycling of lithium battery materials. The company primarily serves the lithium battery and new energy industries, focusing on solid-state electrolyte materials and lithium battery raw materials. Xinliyuan operates multiple research centers in Beijing and Henan and has completed over 470 project research results, serving clients across multiple provinces and cities nationwide.
core_offerings: Lithium Battery Material Project Research Services
Lithium Battery Material Supply Chain Solutions
Solid-State Lithium Battery Research and Development

description: Chongqing Taibang New Energy Co., Ltd. (重庆太蓝新能源有限公司) is a Chinese company engaged in the research, development, and industrialization of new solid-state lithium batteries and key lithium battery materials. The company serves the automotive, commercial vehicle, and energy storage sectors, targeting business clients. It operates multiple production and research facilities across China, including facilities in Beijing, Shunyi, Chongqing, and Anhui.
core_offerings: Lithium Battery Materials Research and Development

description: Sepion Technologies, Inc. is a United States company engaged in materials solutions for the electrify-everything revolution, with a focus on lithium-ion and lithium-metal battery separators. The company operates in the research and product development sector, utilizing nanoscience, polymer chemistry, and machine-learning-driven materials discovery to design and produce coated separator technology for electric vehicle and energy storage applications. Sepion Technologies collaborates with automakers, cell manufacturers, and component manufacturers to improve battery performance and energy density.
